crossRefs.note: This greeting is by me, Paul, with my own hand.
The greeting of me, Paul, with my own hand, which is the sign in every letter: this is how I write.
Therefore don’t be ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, nor of me his prisoner; but endure hardship for the Good News…
Remember those who are in bonds, as bound with them, and those who are ill-treated, since you are also in the body.
And the God of peace will quickly crush Satan under your feet. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all! Amen.
The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, God’s love, and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit be with you all. Amen.

translations.web: The salutation of me, Paul, with my own hand: remember my bonds. Grace be with you. Amen.
translations.bsb: This greeting is in my own hand—Paul. Remember my chains. Grace be with you.
